name: qkd_pvr_exit-v1-COMMIT
purpose: PV pair RESULT TRUNK exit stage (RTL-BUILD-KV/PVTRUNK, x1 per pair at the strip W corner facing pvfin): the 534-b pvfin p word {valid, beat, epoch, data} = the trunk word registered + the control-tile epoch latched on beat 0; trunk in on E, p out on N; 108 x 108 pin-limited square (<= 6 pins / um on every face)

bench.name: lint
bench.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN} && printf '%s\n' 'module ot_lint_top; qkd_pvr_exit u_top (); endmodule' > {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv && verilator --lint-only -Wno-fatal -Wno-lint -Wno-style -Wno-TIMESCALEMOD -Wno-MULTIDRIVEN -Wno-MODMISSING -DSYNTHESIS --top-module ot_lint_top {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv rtl/qwen_sys/kv_rly_std_20261016/qkd_pvr_trunk.sv && echo lint-ok

bench.name: neg_mutant
bench.note: OT_QKD_PVR_MUT: no beat-0 epoch latch -> an epoch change mid-stream relabels the beats

bench.name: pair_trunk_exact
bench.cmd: env PVRT=1 PVRM=0 JOBS=4 bash tools/qwen_kv_die/pv_trunk_bench.sh {RUN}/pair 0 0 "100 4097"
bench.note: the PV pair qkd_pvw_die_r with the 16 inject stages + exit: 32 beats at out_age + RES_D + b, each = the reference po slice and the golden

calibrate.reason: ref_tile: boundary referenced in-run to the propagated tree (io_ref_skew.sdc), as the Qwen die masters

route.cmd: export OT_TTB_CORNER_MARK={CL}/ttb_corner.txt && python3 tools/closure_loop/tt_overlay.py {SRC} && export OT_CTS_FIX_HOOKS='physical/common_flow/cg_pushdown.tcl physical/common_flow/clk_net_protect.tcl physical/common_flow/link_budget_hook.tcl'; export OT_ORFS_CORNER_OVERRIDE=TC; HM=0.03 OT_MM_FF_SDC='physical/ref_tile/qkd_pvr_exit/signoff.sdc' SRC={SRC} OT_PIN_GROUP_MAX=32 bash tools/ref_tile/ref_route.sh physical/ref_tile/qkd_pvr_exit/kit.env {LABEL} {RUN}/routes

collect.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN}/record/route {RUN}/record/views && cp {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/corner_sta.json {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/status {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/STATUS {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/signoff.sdc {RUN}/record/route/ && python3 tools/ref_tile/ref_tile.py export --orfs-dir {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/work/orfs --kit physical/ref_tile/qkd_pvr_exit --out {RUN}/record/views/qkd_pvr_exit  > {RUN}/record/route/export.log 2>&1

budget.reason: ref_tile: boundary budget 0.2 T applied in-run
